title: Complete manifolds with nonnegative Ricci curvature and slow relative volume growth
summary: For any complete and noncompact manifold $M$ with $\mathrm{Ric}\ge 0$, we define a function $\mathrm{RV}(s)$ that describes the growth of relative volume asymptotically $$\mathrm{RV}(s)=\limsup_{r\to\infty} \dfrac{\mathrm{vol} B_{rs}(p)}{\mathrm{vol} B_r(p)},\quad s\ge 1.$$ Then we study the fundamental groups of such manifolds with slow relative volume growth and sublinear diameter growth.
